negative_condition: A filesystem traversal that encounters a directory cycle (via hardlink or duplicate inode) or attempts to cross device boundaries must not loop and must not produce unbounded partial errors.

mutated_contract.violation: Cycle or device boundary cross without bounding — traversal loops or produces >100 partial errors per payload.

assertion: Cycles are detected via device+inode identity tracking and skipped with at most one partial error per identity. Cross-device entries produce bounded partial errors (capped at 100 per payload). The scan terminates and returns partial or complete status — never loops indefinitely.
